purpose: Map the smallest harness surface required to validate an operation before execution, validate its observed result against domain rules, and emit a causally linked successor event without trusting agent prose as proof.

directories.purpose: Typed gate maps, registries, schemas, fixtures, workflows, and artifact contracts.
Scoped agent procedure for selecting and operating the deterministic gates.
Repository-owned deterministic completeness and contract validators.
Dependency-free behavioral checks for gate and cascade semantics.
Human-readable state, known traps, proof ceiling, and handoff guidance.

commands.name: Typed cascade one-command proof
commands.proof: tracked harness structure plus synthetic gate/cascade semantics

commands.name: Dependency-free behavior
commands.proof: pre-gate, post-gate, causality, and terminal-classification semantics

knownTraps: Do not treat Python or JSON permissiveness as an input contract; the pre-action gate must validate required fields, types, ranges, and enums before execution.
Do not treat a structurally valid result as a semantically valid result; the post-action gate owns domain cardinality, disjointness, enumeration, reference, and world-state coherence.
Do not let the agent mutate external state and then ask validation to catch up. The deterministic action boundary owns mutation; agent reasoning remains proposal/selection only.
Do not emit a success successor after either gate rejects the chain.
Do not reuse a stale result or event from another run, correlation ID, or action ID.
Do not claim OWL, SHACL, Pydantic, or another runtime library is installed merely because this contract uses equivalent validation roles.
proofCeiling: Repository structure, typed-gate contracts, synthetic ontology rules, workflow causality, and offline validation only; no product dispatcher, external side effect, live event delivery, Pydantic runtime, OWL reasoner, SHACL engine, or target behavior is proven.
